what: The time since your last hit counts up each frame; after T.regenDelay (3.5 s) without a hit, your health climbs at T.regenRate (16 HP/s) up to your class's max health (ps.maxHealth, set by applyUnit: 100, 150, 120 or 110). A hit resets the timer in applyDamage; resupply, respawn and round reset set it to 99 so regen starts at once. Bots do not regenerate.
where: shamble-game.js:685 ps.lastHitT; :1517 reset to 0 in applyDamage; :2699-2700 timer and regen tick; set to 99 at :1815 (tryResupply), :1827 (playerRespawn), :1843 (resetRound); T.regenDelay 3.5 / regenRate 16 at shamble-core.js:77; the cap ps.maxHealth from applyUnit :1158 (UNIT_TYPES maxHealth at shamble-core.js:128-137)
evidence: Code read: grep regenDelay/regenRate gives only shamble-core.js:77 and shamble-game.js:2700 (player only, no bot path). Values listed in LEGACY_TUNING.md:126-127. No measurement recorded.
v2_note: LOOP_V2 does not mention health regeneration, so whether v2 keeps it (and for bots and humans alike) is a design question for Mustafa. If kept: one rule for every soldier in the sim, delay and rate as data, the timer reset by the server's damage event. The HUD write inside the tick belongs to the client.
reason: Health is authoritative sim state and regen decides who survives the next fight, if v2 keeps it: LOOP_V2 is silent, so keeping it is Mustafa's decision.
